chunks: And with this chain of transmission, from Saʿd ibn Ṭarīf, from Abū Jaʿfar عليه السلام, who said:
Whoever shrouds a believer is like one who has guaranteed his clothing until the Day of Resurrection.

key_terms.كَفَّنَ: prepared the funeral shroud for the deceased
key_terms.يَوْمِ الْقِيَامَةِ: the Day of Resurrection, when people are raised for judgment

ai.seo_question: What is the reward for shrouding a deceased believer in Islam?
ai.summary: This hadith highlights the great merit of shrouding a deceased believer. It portrays this act of care and dignity as a lasting service whose reward extends until the Day of Resurrection.
